t: A micro:bit camera add-on that recognizes faces, balls, and cards using MakeCode blocks.
steps: Find the Smart AI Lens Kit from ELECFREAKS and check the product page.
Buy a micro:bit V1 or V2 and a TPBot or Nezha kit.
Connect the lens to the micro:bit with the RJ11 cable.
Open Microsoft MakeCode in a browser and add the lens blocks.
Test face recognition and ball tracking with the included cards and balls.
Teach the lens a custom object with the button.
Ask IT to check which online tools the class will use.
